intro: Togo's economy relies on its deep-water port, phosphates and farming.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: The port of Lomé is one of West Africa's busiest container ports. Phosphates, cotton, cocoa and coffee are exported.

chapters.title: Farming
text: Most people farm maize, yams and cassava.

keyTerms.meaning: A port big ships can enter.

cardGroups.title: Made in Togo
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Togo makes and sells to the world.
